contract: one counterexample per required AC (test-plan §8); each patch deviates minimally from the v0.12 contract at the seam the bound test reads, nothing else

verification.write_head_session: 2026-10-19 M-TEST WRITE dispatch: the implementation tree is pre-v0.12 (install/version/serve lifecycle/review thread write are legal Red).
